visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Set, Clear and Toggle Bits
visualizerParams.description: OR with a mask sets a bit, AND with the inverted mask clears it, XOR toggles it, and shifting right then AND 1 reads it.

tests.pattern:
(?<![\s\S])\s*flags = 9[ 	]*?
after clearing bit 0 = 8[ 	]*?
after toggling bit 5 = 40[ 	]*?
bit 3 is set\s*(?![\s\S])
